metadata.description: Additional file 1: Supplementary Figures. Fig. S1. Construction of CRISPR genome-wide and surfaceome libraries. Fig. S2. Quality analyses of constructed genome-wide and surfaceome CRISPR libraries. Fig. S3. Evaluation of surfaceome and genome-wide CRISPR libraries. Fig. S4. Validation of the screening results. Fig. S5. Determination of gene modification efficiency. Fig. S6. Validation of the top 10 hits from surfaceome and genome-wide screens. Fig. S7. Construction and validation of single clones of ICAM-1-/-, RAB5C-/-, OLFML3-/-, SLC4A7-/- and ATP6AP1-/+ H1-Hela cells. Fig. S8. Validation of the effects of ICAM-1, RAB5C and OLFML3 on RV infection, related to Fig. 3. Fig. S9. Dissection of the functions of RAB5C and OLFML3 in RV infection. Fig. S10. RNA-seq analyses of the effects of RAB5C knockout on RV infection. Fig. S11. RNA-Seq analyses of the effects of OLFML3 on RV infection (related to Fig. 4). Fig. S12. Bar plots showing RT-qPCR quantification of ISG expression in mock and OLML3-/- cells at 24 h post infection of RV-B14 (a) and RV-A16 (b) at an MOI of 2.
